# Brightwave

- **What:** mid-market consumer-goods distributor; ships to retail and direct-to-consumer.
- **Size:** ~600 employees; three regional distribution centers.
- **Stage:** profitable, privately held; expanding DTC.
- **Operations org:** led by [Jordan Avery](../profile/principal.md); ~120 people across
  fulfilment, warehousing, and supplier management.
